description: Practice page X-02 (pages/practice/exercises.qmd), Part 2 section: the setting that the Part 2 feedback adds (settings.pi70, the cut-off 1 - tau at tau = .30; the answer tolerances are settings.x02.* keys of practice-p1.json and settings.json) and the answers and feedback values that the Part 2 specs do not hold, each recomputed here from the same engine calls as the Part 2 pages (six sites on score A, the released error array; the theory book's three-unit law of ch. 10). Every other answer and mistake value of the Part 2 items is a key of a Part 2 spec. A typed answer must read as a decimal, so the answer of a fraction-valued quantity gets a decimal display here (x02.p2.law3.tau20.optrisk beside tb10.law3.tau20.optrisk, 11/60).

x02.p2.six.all.tau30.note: the exact optimum among all 4,683 reports of the six sites on score A at tau = .30 (between the change points .1884 and .3618, so the same report as at tau = .20)

x02.p2.six.r123333.tau20.note: {A} > {B} > {C, D, E, F}, one of the choices of the G-03 prediction (its risk is six.A.r123333.tau20.risk in part2.json)

x02.p2.law3.note: theory book ch. 10: orders ABC 3/5, ACB 3/20, BAC 3/20, CBA 1/10 (the same input as tb10.law3 in part2.json)

x02.p2.law3.tau20.note: the exact optimum within A_3 (13 reports) at tau = .20

x02.p2.six.all.tau30.N.note: pairs stated by the best report with no cap at tau = .30: every pair but C-D

x02.p2.six.r123333.N.note: pairs stated by {A} > {B} > {C, D, E, F}: A above five sites, B above four

x02.p2.six.r123333.E.note: expected wrong directions of the same report, given in the question

x02.p2.six.r123333.errorTerm.note: X-02 feedback value: E/M alone, the risk without the price of the withheld pairs

x02.p2.six.r123333.whTerm.note: X-02 feedback value: tau (M - N)/M alone, the risk without the expected wrong directions

x02.p2.r122223.withheld.note: X-02 feedback value: the pairs inside the middle grade of {A} > {B, C, D, E} > {F}, the pairs that report withholds

x02.p2.law3.tau20.optrisk.note: 11/60 as a decimal, the typed answer of the X-02 question on the G-04 preset finite (the same value as tb10.law3.tau20.optrisk)
